First Time K2/spice Experience
Someone gave me an unknown substance which originated from someone who (maybe) originally thought it was weed.  The original purchaser had become 'too stoned' and was scared in his experience (this fellow is not really a good judge of anything).
I recognized that this substance was not weed and guessed that it was spice.  I've smoked it a couple times.  It tastes and feels like a dirty, nasty, plasticky substitute for real weed.  I kind of feel altered and have some of the negative side effects from weed (like forgetfullness) but everything feels and tastes synthetic and it is a very poor substitute.  Like substituting margarine for butter but worse. Not a nightmare but definitely disappointing.
